type Name = string
type Amount = int

type User = { name: string, active: boolean }

export const activeNames = (users: User[]): Name[] =>
  users
    |> filter((user) => user.active)
    |> map((user) => user.name)

export const total = (amounts: Amount[]): Amount =>
  amounts |> fold(0, (sum, amount) => sum + amount)

import { displayName, Name, StoreUnavailable } from "./users.eff"
import { UsersLive } from "host:providers"

export const main = (): Name
  fails StoreUnavailable =>
  provide(UsersLive, () => displayName("u1"))
